acceptanceCriteria: re-running ticket create with the same --request-id and byte-identical --payload-stdin returns the original ticketId with replayed:true, or the refusal documents which non-payload input made the request differ
a test covers the identical-payload create replay
body: Suspected defect, observed 2026-10-15 ~02:50Z with corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.523 (cwd a worktree of corvint at origin/main). Repro: corvint-tasks ticket create --request-id fu0285-ccf002-20261015 --payload-stdin < F succeeded (created V1-1381; its output was lost to a local jq error). Re-running the exact same command seconds later with the same file bytes returned outcome REFUSED, code REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT, warning 'different original request', ticketId empty. Same for V1-1382/V1-1383. Expected: an idempotent replay (replayed:true, the original ticketId), so an agent whose first output was lost can recover the ID safely. Actual: refusal with no ID; recovery needed a title search. Unconfirmed which input differs (actor, clock, or cwd may be part of the request digest).
title: corvint-tasks ticket create: identical-payload retry with the same request-id is refused REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT instead of replaying
